title: An SQL query is built from a variable by string concatenation or interpolation.
description: An SQL query is built from a variable by string concatenation or interpolation. If the variable can contain user input this is SQL injection. Use prepared statements.

title: User input reaches an SQL query without parameterization.
description: User input reaches an SQL query without parameterization. An attacker can read or modify the database (SQL injection). Use prepared statements with bound parameters.

title: User input is written to the HTML response without escaping (cross-site scripting).
description: User input is written to the HTML response without escaping (cross-site scripting). An attacker can run JavaScript in other users' browsers. Escape with htmlspecialchars().

title: User input reaches an operating system command.
description: User input reaches an operating system command. An attacker can run arbitrary commands on the server. Avoid shell commands or pass each argument through escapeshellarg().

title: User input controls the path of an include/require statement.
description: User input controls the path of an include/require statement. An attacker can read local files or execute code (file inclusion). Map allowed values to fixed paths instead.

title: User input is passed to unserialize().
description: User input is passed to unserialize(). Crafted payloads can trigger object injection and remote code execution. Use json_decode() for untrusted data.

title: User input controls an HTTP header such as Location (open redirect / header injection).
description: User input controls an HTTP header such as Location (open redirect / header injection). Only redirect to allow-listed, relative URLs.

title: User input is evaluated as PHP code.
description: User input is evaluated as PHP code. An attacker can execute arbitrary code on the server. Never pass request data to eval(), assert() or create_function().

title: An SQL query is built from a variable by string concatenation or interpolation.
description: An SQL query is built from a variable by string concatenation or interpolation. If the variable can contain user input this is SQL injection. Use prepared statements.

title: A password is hashed with a fast, broken hash function (MD5/SHA-1).
description: A password is hashed with a fast, broken hash function (MD5/SHA-1). Use password_hash() with PASSWORD_DEFAULT or PASSWORD_ARGON2ID.
